changelog: Channels are now published to Jellyfin itself, so they can be browsed and played on every client instead of only in the web UI: a "TV-Sender" entry appears in the library, with one folder per channel holding whatever is on air. Playing it joins the channel at the live position - the program's own file plays directly, nothing is streamed or transcoded by the plugin. Can be switched off in the plugin settings.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
